note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref) — founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere. It replaces the 1962 UBS Bible (© UBS) these quotations first used.
A `mined` row means the quotation is a verbatim OWB substring, spliced by script from the bundled text, never typed.

1 Timothy 1:17 (block 11) is the whole OWB verse. Deuteronomy 32:35 ("Their foot shall slide in due time", the Enfield text) is the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause, «እግራቸው በሚንሸራተትበት ጊዜ». The jailer's question (Acts 16:30) is quoted in the English without a citation; its Amharic is the OWB clause «ለመዳን ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?» (OWB's vocative «ጌቶቼ፣» dropped, as the English drops "Sirs"), and the same words recur verbatim in the FAQ answer on the Enfield sermon. 2 Corinthians 1:14 (the Farewell Sermon text) is cited, not quoted, so it carries no row.
